q: भविष्यमा प्रदेश निजामती सेवाको निमित्त अयोग्य नठहरिने गरी सेवाबाट हटाउने सजाय कुन अवस्थामा दिइन्छ?
o: नैतिक पतन देखिने फौजदारी अभियोग लागेमा
e: नियम १०० (ख) (१) अनुसार कार्यक्षमताको अभाव भएमा भविष्यमा अयोग्य नठहरिने गरी हटाइन्छ। भ्रष्टाचार र नैतिक पतनमा भने बर्खास्त गरिन्छ।

q: आर्थिक कार्यविधि तथा वित्तीय उत्तरदायित्व ऐन, २०७६ अनुसार मध्यमकालीन खर्च संरचना (MTEF) को खाका कति वर्षको अवधिको तयार गर्नुपर्छ?
e: बजेट निर्माणलाई यथार्थपरक बनाउन हरेक वर्ष आगामी ३ वर्षको खर्चको अनुमानित खाका (MTEF) तयार गरिन्छ।

q: नेपालको संविधानको धारा २४१ बमोजिम महालेखापरीक्षकले कुन संस्थाको प्रत्यक्ष लेखापरीक्षण गर्दैन तर परामर्श अनिवार्य हुन्छ?
o: ५० प्रतिशतभन्दा बढी स्वामित्व भएको संगठित संस्था
e: सार्वजनिक संस्थानहरूको लेखापरीक्षण गर्न महालेखापरीक्षकको परामर्श अनिवार्य रूपमा लिनुपर्ने संवैधानिक व्यवस्था छ।

q: सार्वजनिक सेवा वडापत्रलाई कसको अधिकार पत्रको रूपमा लिइन्छ?
e: नागरिक बडापत्रले सेवाग्राही (नागरिक) लाई सेवा प्राप्त गर्ने अधिकार प्रदान गर्दछ।

q: सूचनाको हक सम्बन्धी ऐन, २०६४ बमोजिम वर्गीकृत सूचना अधिकतम कति वर्षसम्म गोप्य राख्न सकिन्छ?
e: राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा सम्बन्धी गम्भीर सूचनाहरू दफा २७ बमोजिम ३० वर्षसम्म संरक्षण गर्न सकिने व्यवस्था छ।

q: कुनै वडाको केन्द्र हेरफेर गर्न आवश्यक भएमा सभाको कति बहुमतले प्रस्ताव पारित गर्नुपर्छ?
e: दफा ६ (७) बमोजिम वडाको केन्द्र हेरफेर गर्न तत्काल कायम रहेको सदस्य संख्याको दुई तिहाइ बहुमत आवश्यक पर्दछ।

q: सार्वजनिक खरिद ऐन, २०६३ अनुसार कति रकमसम्मको खरिद गर्न लागत अनुमान (Cost Estimate) गर्नु पर्ने छैन?
e: निर्माण कार्य बाहेक एक लाख रुपैयाँसम्मको खरिद गर्न लागत अनुमान गर्नु पर्ने छैन।

q: २०२५ को आर्थिक स्वतन्त्रता सूचकांक (Economic Freedom Index) अनुसार नेपाल कति औँ स्थानमा रहेको छ?
e: सन् २०२५ को प्रतिवेदन अनुसार नेपाल १३१ औँ स्थानमा परेको छ।

q: नेपालको संविधानको कुन भागदेखि कुन भागसम्म १३ वटा संवैधानिक निकाय सम्बन्धी व्यवस्था गरिएको छ?
e: संविधानको भाग २१ (अख्तियार) देखि भाग २७ (अन्य आयोगहरू) सम्म संवैधानिक निकायको व्यवस्था छ।

q: कुन माध्यमबाट पत्र पठाइएको हो भन्ने कुराको जानकारी कहाँबाट प्राप्त हुन्छ?
e: चलानी किताबमा पत्र पठाइएको माध्यम (साधारण, जरुरी, तुरुन्त) उल्लेख गरिन्छ।

q: The exterior corner of wall is known as .................
e: Quoins are large rectangular blocks of masonry used to reinforce exterior corners of a building.

q: The maximum permissible differential settlement in the case of foundations on sandy soils is generally about .................
e: Sandy soils allow less differential settlement compared to clayey soils, typically limited to 25 mm.

q: The minimum depth of foundation below the ground level in any soil is .................
e: Generally, foundations should be at least 80 cm to 90 cm deep to be safe from seasonal moisture changes.

q: The safe bearing capacity of the soil can be improved by .................
e: All listed methods help consolidate or reinforce the soil to carry more load.

q: The soil investigation method using the penetrometers belongs to the category of .................
e: Sub-surface sounding involves pushing or driving a probe into the ground to measure resistance.

q: A 'Check Valve' (Non-Return Valve) is installed in a pumping system to:
o: Allow water to flow in only one direction
e: Check valves prevent backflow, ensuring water moves only toward the discharge side.

q: A 'Bulkhead' light fixture is most commonly used in:
e: Bulkhead lights are heavy-duty, weather-resistant fixtures designed for tough environments.

q: Glare' is caused by:
e: Glare occurs when a light source is significantly brighter than its surroundings, causing discomfort.

q: The area of most acute vision of a driver is a cone of ............
e: The central cone of highly focused vision (foveal vision) is approximately 3 degrees.

q: Economic survey of a proposed road project includes a detailed survey of ............
o: agricultural and industrial products in the area
e: Economic survey assesses the potential traffic generation based on local production and trade.

q: A river training work is generally required when the river is .............
e: Meandering rivers migrate laterally, requiring training works like spurs or embankments to protect banks.

q: A solid construction put across the river to raise its water level and divert the water into the canal, is known as .............
e: A weir is a low-head barrier used to raise the water level for diversion.

q: The yield of the well depends upon the .............
e: Yield is a function of aquifer characteristics, drawdown, and physical well design.

q: An artesian spring is formed .............
o: porous strata enclosed between two impervious strata
e: Artesian conditions occur when groundwater is trapped under pressure between impermeable layers.

q: नुवाकोटको विदुर कुन नदीको किनारमा अवस्थित छ ?
e: विदुर नगरपालिका त्रिशुली नदीको किनारमा अवस्थित छ।

q: नेपालमा शासन गर्ने पहिलो वंश कुन हो ?
e: नेपालको इतिहासमा गोपालवंशलाई पहिलो शासक वंश मानिन्छ।

q: तलका मध्ये कुन कृति भानुभक्त आचार्यको होइन ?
e: शकुन्तला महाकवि लक्ष्मीप्रसाद देवकोटाको कृति हो।

q: गिद्धे प्रेसको स्थापना कहिले भएको हो ?
e: जंगबहादुर राणाले बेलायतबाट फर्किदा १९०८ मा यो प्रेस ल्याएका थिए।

q: हरेक वर्ष बाघ दिवस कहिले मनाइन्छ ?
e: International Tiger Day is observed globally on July 29th.

q: कुन सिद्धान्तको अनुसन्धान गरिरहेकै बेला आइन्स्टाइनको मृत्यु भएको थियो ?
e: Einstein spent his final years trying to develop a Unified Field Theory to unite all fundamental forces.

q: सेरामिक्सको उपयोगिता कुन हो ?
e: Ceramics are used in engineering, medicine, and household items due to their heat resistance.

q: नेपालको संविधान संविधानसभाबाट कहिले पारित भएको हो ?
e: संविधान भाद्र ३० मा पारित भई असोज ३ मा जारी (जारी) भएको हो।

q: संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघ (UNO) को स्थापना कहिले भएको हो ?
e: UNO was established on October 24, 1945, after WWII.

q: दक्षिण एसियाली क्षेत्रीय सहयोग संगठन (सार्क) को स्थापना कहिले भएको हो ?
e: SAARC was established in Dhaka, Bangladesh on Dec 8, 1985.

q: Chain thin line denotes ............... in engineering drawing.
e: A center line is drawn using long and short dashes (chain line).

q: Orthographic projection represents three dimensional objects in ...........
e: Orthographic projection uses multiple 2D views to represent a 3D object.

q: The main objective of writing letters or alphabets on the drawing is to make the drawing
e: Lettering provides essential dimensions, titles, and notes.

q: The unit of payment for fixing of glass panes or cleaning is in
e: Fixing glass is typically estimated by quantity (Number), whereas supply is by area (Sq.m).

q: The excavation exceeding 1.5 m in width and 10 sq.m in plan area with a depth not exceeding 30 cm, is termed as
e: Surface excavation is shallow but covers a large horizontal area.

q: In the estimation of color washing of A.C corrugated sheet, the plan area is increased by
e: 20% is added for corrugations when estimating surface area for painting/washing.

q: Blast furnace slag cement is used for
e: Slag cement has low heat of hydration and sulfate resistance, making it ideal for mass concrete.

q: The joint preferred in a single brick wall to save facing bricks is
e: Garden wall bond is economical and often used for thin boundary walls.

q: The approximate ratio of the strength of cement concrete at 3 months to that at 28 days of curing is
e: Concrete gains about 15% more strength at 3 months compared to its 28-day strength.

q: Line joining the points of equal declination is called
e: Isogonic lines connect points where magnetic declination is the same.

q: Pantagraph is used for
e: A pantagraph is a mechanical instrument used to copy a drawing to a different scale.

q: Plastering is also called
e: Pargeting is an old term for protective or decorative plastering.

q: Minimum slope for thatched roof is
e: 45 degrees is the minimum steepness needed to drain water quickly from thatch.

q: Which type of cement is used for dam construction?
e: Low Heat Cement is used for dam construction due to its lower heat generation during hydration.

q: The 'Scum' layer in a septic tank acts as:
e: The scum layer prevents air entry, facilitating the anaerobic breakdown of solids.

q: Isogonic line joins points of:
e: Isogonic lines connect points with equal magnetic declination.
